# couchbase-capella_app_endpoint_audit_logging (Resource)

Manages the audit logging configuration of an App Endpoint. Destroying this resource removes it from the Terraform state only. The audit logging configuration in Capella stays in its last state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella_app_endpoint_audit_logging" "new_app_endpoint_audit_logging" {
  organization_id   = "<organization_id>"
  project_id        = "<project_id>"
  cluster_id        = "<cluster_id>"
  app_service_id    = "<app_service_id>"
  app_endpoint_name = "<app_endpoint_name>"

  audit_enabled     = true
  enabled_event_ids = [53280, 53281]

  disabled_users = [
    {
      domain = "sgw"
      name   = "<user_name>"
    }
  ]

  disabled_roles = [
    {
      domain = "sgw"
      name   = "<role_name>"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_endpoint_name` (String) The name of the App Endpoint.
- `app_service_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the appService.
- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.

### Optional

- `audit_enabled` (Boolean) - Determines whether audit logging is enabled
- `disabled_roles` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disabled_roles))
- `disabled_users` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disabled_users))
- `enabled_event_ids` (Set of Number)

<a id="nestedatt--disabled_roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disabled_roles`

Required:

- `domain` (String) - Domain of the user/role. Can be used to filter logs by domain. Example values: sgw cbs
- `name` (String) - Name of the user/role
 - **Constraints**: Maximum length: 256 characters


<a id="nestedatt--disabled_users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disabled_users`

Required:

- `domain` (String) - Domain of the user/role. Can be used to filter logs by domain. Example values: sgw cbs
- `name` (String) - Name of the user/role
 - **Constraints**: Maximum length: 256 characters
